title: Chihaya fourth bailey
visualBrief: Mapped surviving levelled fourth-bailey earthwork at Chihaya Castle: complete retained20-corner lower precinct ground surface and edge slopes, shaped by original numerical elevation values. No surviving keep is claimed. Upper enclosures, ridge ditch, modern shrine/teahouse, signs, steles, trees, whole natural hill and approach staircase are outside this constituent; whole Chihaya Castle remains unfinished.
